package.name: gcs_comms
package.description: GCS communication bridge (gcs_mavlink_node): MAVROS-based link to the ground control station, mission upload state machine, and MC_STATUS/ MC_DETECTION/MC_HEALTH telemetry multiplexer. SDD-MC-001 §11. SRS refs: FR-060-064, IR-010-014. This is a scaffold — the mavros dependency and real node logic land with the gcs_comms implementation work.
